_what: Random fire mask (p = 0.5) against every cell updating every step, all else identical. Test split; K and vessel threshold chosen on validation. 2026-09-24.
_verdict: Without the fire mask the vessel head is better on every seed and the field holds far better over long rollouts; necrosis DSC varies more between seeds (0.844 to 0.910), so the shipped model is the best of three seeds.
